title: Privacy Policy
body:
Shore Haven Media ("we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

## Information We Collect

**Information you provide.** When you fill out our contact form or book a call, we collect the details you submit — such as your name, email address, company, and any message you send us.

**Scheduling information.** If you book a call through our scheduling tool (Calendly), that information — your name, email, and selected time — is processed to arrange the meeting.

**Information collected automatically.** Like most websites, we and our service providers may automatically collect limited technical information when you visit — such as your browser type, device, general location, and pages viewed — through cookies and similar technologies.

## Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the site and to understand how it performs. We also use the **Meta Pixel**, a tool from Meta Platforms (Facebook and Instagram), to measure the effectiveness of our advertising and to show relevant ads to people who have visited our site.

You can control cookies through your browser settings, and you can manage ad personalization through your Meta account settings. Where required, we will ask for your consent before placing non-essential cookies.

## How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

- Respond to your inquiries and communicate with you
- Schedule and conduct calls or meetings
- Operate, maintain, and improve our website
- Measure and improve our marketing and advertising

We do not sell your personal information.

## How Your Information Is Shared

We share information only as needed to run our business, including with service providers who help us operate:

- **Netlify** — website hosting and contact-form processing
- **Calendly** — scheduling
- **Meta Platforms** — advertising measurement via the Meta Pixel
- **Google Fonts** — typography delivery

Each of these providers processes data under their own privacy policies. We may also disclose information if required by law.

## Data Retention

We keep the information you submit for as long as needed to respond to you and for our legitimate business purposes, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

## Your Choices and Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to object to certain processing. To make a request, email us at **hello@shorehavenmedia.com** and we will respond as required by applicable law.

## Children's Privacy

Our website is intended for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

## Links to Other Sites

Our site may link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their policies.

## Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date shown above.

## Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or the information we hold, contact us at **hello@shorehavenmedia.com**.
